login.title: Cashier sign-in
login.subtitle: Use your Echo Grid staff account. This device gets its own cashier session.
login.deviceLabelHint: For example, Counter 1. Your manager sees it in the session list.

errors.credentials: That email or password is not correct.
errors.access: This account cannot use the cashier app. Ask your manager for access.
errors.expired: This sign-in expired. Please sign in again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.managedCredentials: That business code, username or password is not correct.

login.chooseHint: Choose the business and branch for this device.

managed.useCode: Sign in with a business code instead
managed.businessCodeHint: Ask your manager for the business code and your username.

redeem.title: Redeem a reward code
redeem.subtitle: Type the code the customer shows, check what it is for, then confirm.

account.title: This device
account.signOutHint: Ends only this cashier session. Your other devices and the business dashboard stay signed in.

install.title: Install the cashier app
install.ios: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.installed: The cashier app is installed on this device.
install.manual: If there is no Install button above, your browser has not offered one yet. In Chrome or Edge open the browser menu and choose Install app (or Add to Home screen).

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Customer lookups, purchases and redemptions need a connection. Nothing is saved offline. Reconnect to continue.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The cashier app could not load this screen. Your session is safe. Try again.

dashboard.title: Cashier app
dashboard.subtitle: A focused counter app for serving customers on a phone or tablet, with its own sign-in.
dashboard.unavailable: The cashier app is not available yet for this environment. Your owner or platform administrator will let you know when it is.
dashboard.access: Your role gives you access to the cashier app. Sign in there with your normal staff email and password.
dashboard.noAccess: Your role does not include serving customers, so the cashier app is not available to you.
dashboard.installIntro: Open the cashier app on the counter device, then install it so it opens like an app.

steps.android: Android (Chrome): open the cashier app, then tap the menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
steps.ios: iPhone and iPad (Safari): open the cashier app, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
steps.desktop: Computer (Chrome or Edge): open the cashier app and click the install icon in the address bar.

dashboard.unsupportedNote: If your browser cannot install apps, the cashier app still works in a normal browser tab.
dashboard.ownerNote: As an owner you can use and install the cashier app without any extra setup or approval.

sessions.title: Active cashier sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices currently signed in to the cashier app for this business.
sessions.confirmAll: Sign out every cashier device for this business? Staff will need to sign in again.
sessions.failed: Could not sign the device out. Try again.

activity.title: Cashier activity
activity.subtitle: What happened at the counter: lookups, QR checks, points, redemptions and device sessions.

actions.cashier_session_revoked: Cashier device signed out by manager

activity.empty: No cashier activity matches these filters.
activity.noAccess: Your role cannot view cashier activity. Ask the business owner or an administrator.
activity.branchRequired: Choose a branch to view its activity.

accounts.title: Cashier accounts
accounts.subtitle: Create sign-ins for your cashiers without needing their email address, and choose which branches each one can serve.
accounts.noAccess: Your role cannot manage cashier accounts. Ask the business owner for access.
accounts.loadFailed: Cashier accounts could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

reauth.title: Confirm it is you
reauth.hint: Changes to cashier accounts need your password. Confirming lasts 5 minutes.
reauth.confirmed: Confirmed. You can make changes for the next 5 minutes.

code.title: Business code
code.hint: Cashiers sign in with this code, their username and their password. It is not a secret, but change it if it is shared by mistake.
code.none: Created with your first cashier account.
code.confirmRotate: Change the business code? Cashiers will need the new code the next time they sign in. Signed-in cashiers are not signed out.

create.title: Create a cashier account
create.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot, underscore or hyphen.
create.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate a secure password. If you set one, it must be at least 8 characters.

assign.singleHint: The cashier serves at one branch only.
assign.multipleHint: The cashier chooses between the branches you tick, and no others.
assign.removeNote: Removing a branch signs out the cashier's sessions on that branch straight away.

actions.confirmReset: Reset this cashier's password? Their current sessions end and you will see the new password once.
actions.confirmDisable: Disable this account? It is signed out now and cannot sign in until you enable it.
actions.confirmSignOut: Sign this cashier out of every device?
actions.confirmRevoke: Revoke this account permanently? This cannot be undone.

credential.title: Save this sign-in now
credential.warning: This password is shown only once and cannot be recovered. Give it to the cashier securely.

errors.generic: That could not be done. Try again.
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: Confirm your password above, then try again.
errors.CASHIER_USERNAME_TAKEN: That username is already used in this business.
errors.CASHIER_USERNAME_INVALID: Usernames are 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot, underscore or hyphen.
errors.CASHIER_BRANCH_ASSIGNMENT_INVALID: Choose one branch for single access, or at least two for several.
errors.CASHIER_BRANCH_NOT_FOUND: One of the chosen branches was not found.
errors.CASHIER_ACCOUNT_STATE_CONFLICT: That is not possible for the account's current status.
errors.CASHIER_ACCOUNT_REVOKED: A revoked account cannot be changed.
errors.CASHIER_ROLE_NAME_CONFLICT: A custom role named Cashier already exists. Rename it first.
errors.CASHIER_ROLE_ALTERED: The Cashier role was changed and no longer matches its fixed permissions.
errors.CASHIER_CATALOG_NOT_SEEDED: Cashier accounts are not available yet. Contact support.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to do that.

branchSwitch.title: Switch branch
branchSwitch.hint: Choose the branch you are serving at now. You stay signed in.
branchSwitch.loadFailed: The branches could not be loaded.
branchSwitch.denied: You can no longer serve at that branch. The list has been updated.
branchSwitch.conflict: The branch changed in another window. The list has been updated.
branchSwitch.unavailable: Switching is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
